race.verdict: TUNE IN A BOX has fallen to a handy mark and may well capitalise with a comeback run under his belt. The main danger is Bowmore , who returns with his yard among the winners and could poach an easy lead. TUNE IN A BOX (IRE) BOWMORE (IRE) QUEENIE ST CLAIR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Letterston Lily (11/4), Tune In A Box (3/1), Bowmore (7/2), Moab (4/1), Queenie St Clair (8/1), Minella Crooner (12/1)
